name: Pertamina Mandalika International Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Grand Prix circuit (4.301 km, 17 corners: 11 right, 6 left), clockwise

start_finish.source: Approximate: middle of the main straight alongside the OSM Mandalika Paddock Building (way 1041715055, the pit building), checked in the Sentinel-2 L2A scene S2A_50LMR_20260925 (10 m); no OSM start/finish tag exists and 10 m imagery cannot show the grid

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges
